description: Analysis overlay style shared by the browser (frontend/src/player/overlay.ts) and the MP4 export (backend/fight_analyzer/export/render.py), so both show the same effects at the same video times. Times are seconds of video time relative to the event moment (peak), never wall-clock time. Colours are the vivid video-layer versions of the interface corner colours (frontend/src/styles/tokens.css); outline and light are the black contour and white marks used for contrast on the picture.
